name: SindiPay Payment Gateway
author: sindipay

sections.description:
The #1 Payment Gateway for Iraq 🇮🇶

SindiPay is the leading payment gateway specialized for Iraqi businesses. Accept all Iraqi bank cards including Qi Card and expand your business across Iraq with confidence!

Why Choose SindiPay?

  • ✅ Specialized for Iraq: Built specifically for the Iraqi market
  • ✅ All Iraqi Cards Supported: Qi Card, MasterCard Iraq, Visa Iraq, and all local Iraqi bank cards
  • ✅ Grow Your Business in Iraq: Reach millions of Iraqi customers
  • ✅ Fast Setup: Get started in less than 3 hours
  • ✅ 24/7 Local Support: Iraqi team available around the clock
  • ✅ Arabic & English: Full bilingual support

Features

  • 🇮🇶 Accept all Iraqi bank cards (Qi Card, local debit/credit cards)
  • 🚀 Easy integration with WooCommerce
  • 📱 Support for WooCommerce Blocks (Cart & Checkout Blocks)
  • 🔒 Secure payment processing through SindiPay API
  • 🌍 Multiple language support (Arabic & English)
  • ⚡ Real-time payment status updates
  • ✓ Automatic order completion on successful payment
  • 📊 Comprehensive logging for debugging
  • 🕐 24/7 support from Iraqi team

Perfect For

  • E-commerce stores in Iraq
  • Businesses selling to Iraqi customers
  • Local Iraqi merchants
  • International businesses expanding to Iraq
  • Anyone accepting Iraqi bank cards

Supported Languages

  • English (en_US)
  • Arabic (ar)

External Services

This plugin connects to the SindiPay payment processing API to process payments for your WooCommerce store.

What is SindiPay?
SindiPay is a payment gateway service specialized for Iraqi businesses, enabling merchants to accept Iraqi bank cards including Qi Card, Visa, MasterCard, and other local cards.

When is the external service used?
The plugin communicates with SindiPay’s API in the following situations:
1. When a customer initiates a payment at checkout
2. When verifying payment status after a customer returns from the payment page

What data is transmitted?
When processing payments, the following data is sent to SindiPay’s servers:
– Order ID and total amount (required)
– Currency code (required)
– Customer’s email address (optional, if provided by customer)
– Customer’s phone number (optional, if provided by customer)
– Callback and webhook URLs for payment status updates (required)
– Your site’s locale/language preference (required)

Service Information:
– Service URL: https://sindipay.com/api/v1/payments/gateway/
– Terms of Service: https://sindipay.com/terms
– Privacy Policy: https://sindipay.com/privacy

By using this plugin, you agree to transmit the above data to SindiPay’s servers for payment processing purposes. Please ensure you have reviewed SindiPay’s terms of service and privacy policy, and that your customers are aware of this data transmission through your own privacy policy.

Getting Your API Key

To use this plugin, you need to become a SindiPay merchant:

Contact us anytime – We’re available 24/7:
– Phone/WhatsApp: +964 787 877 0990
– Website: https://sindipay.com

Quick Setup (Less than 3 hours):
1. Call or WhatsApp us at +964 787 877 0990 – Available 24/7
2. Provide your business information
3. Get verified and receive your API Key (typically within 3 hours)
4. Copy and paste it into the plugin settings
5. Start accepting payments immediately!

We’re here to help you 24/7 – Day or night, weekend or holiday!

Support

24/7 Support – We’re always here for you!

For support and inquiries:
– Phone/WhatsApp: +964 787 877 0990 (Available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week)
– Website: https://sindipay.com
– WordPress.org: Support forums

Day or night, weekend or holiday – call or message us anytime and we’ll respond immediately!

We’re here to help with merchant registration, technical support, and any questions about accepting payments.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/sindipay-gateway directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments
  4. Find “SindiPay” and click “Manage”
  5. Enable the payment method
  6. Enter your SindiPay API Key (see “Getting Your API Key” below)
  7. Configure the title and description for English and Arabic
  8. Save changes
sections.faq:
Where do I get my API Key?

To get your API Key, you need to become a SindiPay merchant:

Contact us 24/7:
– Call or WhatsApp: +964 787 877 0990 (Available around the clock)
– Visit our website: https://sindipay.com

We’ll guide you through the registration process and provide your API Key within 3 hours. We’re available day and night to assist you!

How do I become a SindiPay merchant?

Contact us directly – We’re available 24/7:
– Phone/WhatsApp: +964 787 877 0990 (Call or message us anytime!)
– Website: https://sindipay.com

Our team will help you with:
1. Merchant registration (Quick and easy)
2. Business verification (Within 3 hours)
3. API Key setup
4. Integration support (24/7 assistance)

No business hours restrictions – Contact us whenever you need!

Does this plugin support WooCommerce Blocks?

Yes! This plugin fully supports the new WooCommerce Cart and Checkout Blocks.

What currencies are supported?

The plugin supports all currencies enabled in your WooCommerce store settings.

Is this plugin secure?

Yes, all payment processing is handled securely through SindiPay’s API using HTTPS connections.

Can I customize the payment method title and description?

Yes! The plugin includes separate fields for English and Arabic titles and descriptions. This allows you to show different text to customers based on their language preference – perfect for Iraqi businesses serving both Arabic and English speaking customers.

Why is SindiPay the best choice for Iraqi businesses?

We’re specialized exclusively for the Iraqi market:

✅ Accept ALL Iraqi bank cards (Qi Card, local Visa, MasterCard, debit/credit)
✅ Local Iraqi support team available 24/7
✅ Fast approval (within 3 hours)
✅ Understand Iraqi business needs
✅ Competitive rates for Iraqi merchants
✅ Help you expand across Iraq
✅ Arabic & English interface
✅ Built for Iraqi payment infrastructure

Whether you’re in Baghdad, Basra, Erbil, or anywhere in Iraq – we’ve got you covered!

What payment cards are accepted?

All Iraqi bank cards are supported!

We accept:
– ✅ Qi Card (كي كارد)
– ✅ All Iraqi Visa cards
– ✅ All Iraqi MasterCard cards
– ✅ All local Iraqi bank debit cards
– ✅ All local Iraqi bank credit cards

We’re specialized for Iraq – If it’s an Iraqi bank card, we support it! Contact us at +964 787 877 0990 for specific card inquiries.

How long does it take to get approved as a merchant?

Fast approval – usually within 3 hours! We work 24/7 to get you up and running as quickly as possible. Call or WhatsApp us at +964 787 877 0990 anytime, and we’ll process your application right away.

Is there a setup fee or monthly fee?

For information about merchant fees and pricing, please contact us:
– Phone/WhatsApp: +964 787 877 0990
– Website: https://sindipay.com
